title: DevGraph — Repository Discovery & Issue Indexing Platform
overview: Repository discovery built around a connected user–repository–issue graph. Independent feed snapshots and local search state keep discovery responsive without refetching on every keystroke.
features: MongoDB repository ownership and issue relationships
Repository create, update, visibility, and delete handlers
Client-side repository name filtering and account login
role: Designed repository relationships and owner/issue population queries, added creation-time name and owner validation, and separated personal repositories from discovery and local search state.
challenges: Resolving owner and issue references while keeping repository mutations and independent client feeds inspectable without refetching on each search keystroke.
impact: Resolved repository owners and issues through document relationships while reusing loaded feed results for local search, avoiding a network request per keystroke.

title: Real-Time Video Conferencing Platform
overview: A room-based video conferencing application using WebRTC for peer connections and Socket.io for signaling. Meeting controls keep microphone, camera, and participant state visible throughout a session.
role: I built the meeting UI, signaling logic, room lifecycle, client-state handling, and deployment configuration.
challenges: Handled real-time connection state, peer negotiation, and graceful updates when users join or leave sessions.
impact: Connects participants through room-based WebRTC sessions, with signaling and media controls organized around each meeting’s lifecycle.

title: LendFlow — Multi-Role Lending & Underwriting Platform
overview: Loan origination, underwriting review, and repayment interfaces organized around borrower, lender, and administrator workflows. Shared loan records keep review outcomes visible across the product.
features: Borrower, lender, and admin dashboard views
Express loan creation and approve/reject endpoints
Sequelize models for users, loans, and related financial records
role: Modeled relational loan records and implemented Express application, lookup, approval, and rejection handlers alongside JWT account authentication and role-oriented React views.
challenges: Keeping borrower relations, principal and interest precision, and explicit pending / approved / rejected values consistent across application and review screens.
impact: Kept lending and repayment interfaces linked to shared borrower and loan records, with persisted review outcomes and fixed-point principal and interest inputs.

title: PERN Stack SaaS Project
overview: A SaaS application built on the PERN stack with a PostgreSQL-backed data model and full-stack product workflows.
role: I implemented database-connected backend routes, frontend screens, API integration, and production deployment flow.
challenges: Structured relational data and API boundaries so the product could remain understandable as features expanded.
impact: Connects a React dashboard to Express APIs and PostgreSQL records, separating data access from interface state across full-stack workflows.

title: SaaS E-Commerce Website
overview: An e-commerce application connecting product discovery, reusable storefront components, and backend catalog workflows across responsive layouts.
role: I built the storefront UI, reusable components, backend integration points, and deployment configuration.
challenges: Solved layout consistency and product presentation challenges across responsive breakpoints and commerce states.
impact: Provides a consistent product-discovery interface through reusable storefront components connected to the application backend.

title: Trading Dashboard — Brokerage Interface
overview: A Zerodha-inspired brokerage interface with trading dashboard layouts, market product pages, and responsive navigation. Reusable React sections organize financial information across desktop and mobile screens.
role: I implemented the frontend experience, reusable UI sections, routing, and deployment-ready project structure.
challenges: Organizing a dense financial interface into reusable sections while maintaining clear navigation and responsive information hierarchy.
impact: Delivers trading and market-product views through shared React components and application routing, with consistent layouts across screen sizes.

title: Agentic AI System
overview: An AI system designed around autonomous task execution, tool usage, and multi-step reasoning workflows.
role: I designed agent workflows, integrated LLM calls, organized backend modules, and prepared the project for iterative extension.
challenges: Managed unpredictable AI outputs with clearer workflow boundaries, validation points, and maintainable orchestration logic.
impact: Organizes model calls and tool execution into modular agent workflows, with explicit handoffs between processing steps.

title: API Issues Debugging Agent
overview: An API diagnostics agent that analyzes failure inputs and returns structured debugging guidance. Backend endpoints connect error details to an LLM analysis workflow for developer troubleshooting.
role: I built the diagnostic workflow, prompt structure, backend endpoints, and response formatting for developer usability.
challenges: Converted noisy API failures into actionable summaries while keeping the output concise and technically useful.
impact: Turns API failure inputs into structured debugging guidance, connecting diagnostic context to likely causes and next steps.

title: Deep Learning — Training & Evaluation Pipeline
overview: A reusable deep-learning pipeline connecting data preparation, TensorFlow/Keras model training, and evaluation. Repeatable processing stages keep model inputs and evaluation outputs consistent across training runs.
role: Implemented data preprocessing, training logic, model evaluation, and workflow documentation using Python, TensorFlow, Keras, NumPy, and Pandas.
challenges: Keeping preprocessing consistent between training and evaluation while making model behavior and results inspectable across repeatable runs.
impact: Brings preprocessing, training, and evaluation into a repeatable workflow, making model results easier to compare and reproduce.

title: Multi-Agent Research System
overview: A multi-agent research workflow that coordinates information gathering, summarization, and answer synthesis.
role: I designed agent roles, orchestration flow, retrieval logic, and output structure for research-ready responses.
challenges: Reduced fragmented research outputs by defining clearer handoffs between collection, analysis, and synthesis steps.
impact: Coordinates information collection, retrieval, and summarization through specialist agents to produce structured research reports.

title: AI Video Assistant
overview: A video-processing application connecting media ingestion, FFmpeg processing, and AI summarization through a Flask API. Separate processing stages handle media inputs and prepare structured results for the interface.
role: I built backend workflows for video handling, AI integration, endpoint design, and response preparation.
challenges: Handled longer-running media tasks by separating processing steps and keeping the user-facing flow understandable.
impact: Connects video ingestion, FFmpeg processing, and AI summarization through one Flask API workflow.

title: WhatsApp Automation API
overview: An API-driven WhatsApp automation project for programmatic messaging workflows and integration-ready communication.
role: I implemented API routes, request handling, automation flow structure, and documentation-friendly backend behavior.
challenges: Designed the API to support predictable messaging workflows while keeping integration points clean and testable.
impact: Exposes messaging workflows through Express endpoints, with request handling and event-oriented integration points for connected applications.

title: MERN Authentication System
overview: A MERN authentication system connecting user registration, password hashing, JWT sign-in, and protected application routes. React account flows share authentication state with the Express API and MongoDB user records.
role: I built the authentication backend, frontend auth flows, route protection, and validation-aware user experience.
challenges: Handled session persistence and protected state consistently across frontend and backend boundaries.
impact: Connects registration and sign-in to password hashing, JWT validation, and protected routes across the frontend and API.

title: UGC Content Studio — AI Media Generation Pipeline
overview: An authenticated image studio that combines product and person references through OpenAI image edits, persists project state in PostgreSQL, and retains output when Cloudinary storage is unavailable.
features: Clerk-authenticated image generation from two uploaded references
OpenAI image edits and Cloudinary storage with database data-URL fallback
Prisma and PostgreSQL user, credit, and project records
Generation state and credit restoration after caught provider failures; unavailable video requests rejected before charging
role: Engineered authenticated image-generation endpoints, two-reference OpenAI requests, storage fallback, and failure-path credit restoration around account-scoped project records.
challenges: Coordinating generation, media uploads, and credit mutations while persisting output URLs, processing flags, and caught provider errors.
impact: Coordinated authenticated reference uploads, generated-media delivery, and recoverable project state in one pipeline, with credit restoration paths for caught generation failures.

title: MemoryGraph AI — Personal Archive & Search
overview: A family-memory archive that connects uploaded documents, images, recordings, and notes to searchable memories, relationship graphs, and timelines. Next.js and FastAPI coordinate extraction, ChromaDB retrieval, and NetworkX relationships, with source records attached to answers.
features: Memory uploads with extraction stages and processing status
People, place, date, and event relationships with a D3 graph
ChromaDB retrieval and source-linked archive questions
Archive ownership and contributor access checks
role: Integrated memory capture and processing with a Next.js interface, FastAPI services, relational archive records, retrieval, relationship visualization, and source-linked answers.
challenges: Keeping extracted text, people and event relationships, retrieval results, and processing state connected to the correct archive and original memory records.
impact: Makes scattered memories searchable as a connected archive, linking answers, timelines, and relationship views back to their saved source records.

title: VidSNAP AI Flask
overview: A Flask-based AI video utility for media processing and assisted video workflows.
role: I built the Flask app structure, AI integration points, media handling flow, and user-facing request lifecycle.
challenges: Handled media processing complexity while keeping the application lightweight and easy to operate.
impact: Connects media file handling, AI processing, and result endpoints through a Flask application with visible processing states.

title: AI Brief — AI News to Email Generator
overview: An AI news reader and personalized newsletter builder collecting OpenAI, Anthropic, and YouTube feeds. OpenAI agents summarize source excerpts, rank stories for a reader’s interests, and produce a source-linked digest for preview, HTML download, or Gmail delivery.
features: Live RSS stories from OpenAI, Anthropic, and YouTube
Search and source filters with 24-hour, 7-day, and 30-day windows
Interest-based curation of three-story or five-story digests
Source-linked summaries with an explanation of each story’s relevance
Digest preview, copy, HTML download, and owner-authenticated Gmail delivery
role: Built the FastAPI web workflow and reading interface, joined RSS collection to parallel OpenAI summarization and relevance ranking, and added HTML export plus authenticated Gmail delivery.
challenges: Preserve source identities and URLs across concurrent feed collection, summarization, and ranking, with cached results and signed previews before email delivery.
impact: Deployed a news-to-newsletter workflow with source filtering, personalized digest generation, readable previews, HTML downloads, and owner-controlled email sending.

title: AI Image Enhancer
overview: An AI image enhancement project for improving uploaded images through a simple user-facing workflow. The application focuses on media upload handling, enhancement logic, and clear before/after value for users.
role: I built the upload flow, backend processing endpoints, result presentation, and error-aware user experience.
challenges: Handled image file inputs and processing states so enhancement results could be delivered consistently.
impact: Connects image uploads to processing endpoints and before/after result views, with recoverable failure states throughout the request.

title: SigmaGPT
overview: A GPT-style conversational AI application focused on prompt interaction, response rendering, and AI-assisted productivity.
role: I implemented the chat UI, request lifecycle, API integration, and response display experience.
challenges: Kept AI conversations readable and responsive while managing loading, error, and empty states.
impact: Provides a conversational interface with server-side model requests and clear loading, failure, and message-rendering states.

title: Stock Prediction Portal — Python & LSTM
overview: A full-stack stock analysis portal combining historical prices, 100-day and 200-day moving averages, and estimates from a trained LSTM model. A React dashboard presents model comparisons and error metrics, with authenticated profiles and personal watchlists.
features: Ticker-based price history and 100-day / 200-day moving-average charts
Historical LSTM estimates with MSE, RMSE, and R-squared evaluation
JWT sign-in, account profiles, and watchlists of up to 10 symbols
Cached market-data requests and prediction responses
role: Built the React analysis portal and Django REST API, connected ticker validation and cached market data to trained LSTM inference, and added authenticated profiles and watchlists.
challenges: Keep price scaling limited to the earlier history segment, batch model inference, and isolate chart rendering while packaging trained weights for serverless execution.
impact: Deployed a stock-analysis workflow combining historical charts, trained-model estimates, evaluation metrics, and per-account watchlists.

title: ASP.NET Core Project
overview: A responsive ASP.NET Core 8 Razor Pages website with shared layouts and pages for company information, services, blog content, and contact details.
features: Razor Pages routing and page models
role: I built the Razor Pages website, page models, shared layouts, and responsive interfaces.
challenges: Kept page structure, navigation, and shared presentation consistent across the site.
impact: Presents company, service, blog, and contact information through a responsive server-rendered website.

title: RailTracker UTS PHP
overview: A PHP-based rail tracking utility focused on transportation workflows, data presentation, and practical user interactions.
role: I implemented server-rendered pages, database operations, user flows, and interface refinements.
challenges: Organized transportation data into usable screens while keeping the application lightweight and accessible.
impact: Connects PHP transport-data views to MySQL records, with navigation and responsive layouts for the rail-tracking workflow.

title: DRF Advanced Project
overview: An advanced Django REST Framework project focused on API architecture, authentication patterns, and backend scalability.
role: I built API endpoints, serializers, permissions, authentication flows, and database-connected backend logic.
challenges: Designed API boundaries and permission handling to keep backend behavior secure, readable, and extensible.
impact: Exposes PostgreSQL-backed workflows through Django REST Framework endpoints, serializers, authentication, and explicit permission checks.

title: WebHook API Integration
overview: A webhook-focused API integration project for receiving external events and processing them through backend workflows.
role: I implemented webhook endpoints, request validation, event routing, and integration-oriented backend structure.
challenges: Handled external event payloads predictably while keeping the processing flow clear and easy to extend.
impact: Routes external event payloads through validated Express webhook endpoints and downstream integration handlers.

title: Django Resume Builder
overview: A Django-based resume builder that helps users create structured professional resumes through guided input flows. The project combines form-heavy workflows, template rendering, and document-oriented user experience.
role: I built Django views, form handling, data models, resume templates, and responsive page layouts.
challenges: Turned multi-section resume data into a structured output flow while keeping the experience simple for users.
impact: Turns structured career information into formatted resumes through Django forms, saved records, and responsive document templates.

title: Office Employee Management System
overview: An employee management system for organizing office staff data, administrative records, and operational workflows.
role: I implemented data models, management views, CRUD flows, validation, and user-facing administration screens.
challenges: Structured office data into reliable workflows that reduce manual tracking and improve administrative clarity.
impact: Centralizes employee records in a Django application with validation, search, and administrative create, update, and delete workflows.

title: RAG Book Assistant — Document Q&A
overview: A deployed Python application that turns selectable PDF text into source-grounded answers. OpenAI embeddings and diversity-aware retrieval find relevant passages, GPT-4o-mini answers from that context, and expandable page excerpts let visitors inspect the evidence.
features: PDF upload with selectable-text extraction and page references
Overlapping document chunks with preserved page numbers
OpenAI embeddings with cosine similarity and maximal marginal relevance retrieval
GPT-4o-mini answers with validated source IDs and expandable page excerpts
Context-aware responses when the document does not contain an answer
Session-isolated document indexes, clear-document controls, and request admission limits
role: Built PDF extraction, overlapping chunking, OpenAI embeddings, MMR retrieval, and structured answer validation; connected them to a session-isolated Streamlit interface and deployed the app with server-side secrets.
challenges: Retrieve useful passages without repeating near-duplicates, preserve page references through generation, and keep each visitor's document separate while bounding public API usage.
impact: Turns PDF content into a searchable conversation with supporting page excerpts, helping readers locate answers and inspect the original source without scanning the full document.

title: Next Word Prediction — LSTM Language Model
overview: A next-word prediction application powered by a trained TensorFlow/Keras LSTM. The Streamlit interface tokenizes partial sentences, prepares the saved model's input sequence, and displays three ranked next-word suggestions with their model probabilities.
features: Partial-sentence input with three ranked next-word suggestions
CPU inference using the original trained Keras H5 model
Saved tokenizer with padding and truncation aligned to the model input shape
Ranked vocabulary predictions with a visible probability distribution
Cached model resources across Streamlit interface reruns
Input validation for empty, oversized, and unknown phrases
role: Connected the trained LSTM, tokenizer, and sequence metadata to a Streamlit application; implemented input validation, CPU inference, cached resource loading, ranked vocabulary decoding, and cloud deployment.
challenges: Align inference with the saved model's actual context length, reuse model resources across interface reruns, and make vocabulary limits and prediction probabilities clear to visitors.
impact: Delivers the trained sequence model through a browser interface, with three ranked word suggestions and cached CPU inference that reuses model resources across requests.
